registration_target: tests/ui-testing/ci-matrix/ci_matrix.json (add to the "Dashboards-Core" shard's run_files array)
rationale: No existing Dashboards spec exercises deep-link default-tab resolution on load (valid / missing / invalid tab query param -> active tab + URL normalization). dashboard-share-link.spec.js covers short-link/share-URL GENERATION (clipboard + /short/ redirect), not loading a /dashboards/view deep link and asserting which tab resolves; dashboard-tabs-setting.spec.js covers tab CRUD in settings. The production change is a null-safety guard in ViewDashboard.vue addPanelData() (route.query.tab ?? currentDashboardData?.data?.tabs?.[0]?.tabId), a distinct behavior area (deep-link tab resolution + the add-panel guard) with no fitting spec, so a dedicated new spec (as named by run-context spec_path) is the least-duplicative option.
